llmJudgeHistorical.reasoning:
The agent performed very well on almost all aspects of this complex error recovery task. It correctly read all sources, interpreted the evidence to conclude delivery had already occurred, suppressed duplicate actions, created the correct new task, and avoided creating a duplicate task.
